span.p:
CI: path-filtered, on pull_request
and push to dev, staging, main
deploy.yml: push to main, or by hand on main; does not wait for CI

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(26, 32, 44) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
images job: 6 images to GHCR, tagged with the commit;
holds no production secrets

div.style: color: rgb(26, 32, 44) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1. each server: copy the release directory,
write app.env, log in to GHCR

div.style: color: rgb(26, 32, 44) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. once, from the first server:
ensure roles and grants, migrate × 3

div.style: color: rgb(26, 32, 44) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. one server at a time, roll.sh: pull, drain, start,
wait for every health check, undrain

div.style: color: rgb(26, 32, 44) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. check all 6 public names;
a failure here rolls nothing back

div.style: color: rgb(26, 32, 44) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
unhealthy: that server goes back,
servers before it are sent back
